name: framefetch
description: Connect Codex to the local FrameFetch Agent and inspect Codex or Claude Code readiness.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex to the local FrameFetch Agent.
interface.longDescription: FrameFetch registers a local MCP server, starts the per-user local Agent on demand, and reports whether Codex and Claude Code are installed and authenticated without copying their credentials.
capabilities: Start and stop the local FrameFetch Agent
Inspect Codex and Claude Code connection readiness
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the FrameFetch local Agent and tell me whether Codex and Claude Code are ready.
